categories.name: Cores
categories.description: Open Space HDL IP cores and their standalone modules.

categories.name: Open Logic
categories.description: Building blocks of the fault-tolerant Open Logic library.

types.name: SpaceWire packets (N-Char)
types.description: Packets as N-Char stream, one data character per beat; a beat with Last is the end of packet marker (data bit 0: '0' EOP, '1' EEP).

types.name: SpaceWire time-codes
types.description: Time-codes of the SpaceWire time-code service (6 bit value).

types.name: SpaceWire interrupts
types.description: Interrupt codes of the SpaceWire distributed interrupt service (5 bit interrupt identifier).

types.name: SpaceWire interrupt acknowledgements
types.description: Interrupt acknowledgement codes of the SpaceWire distributed interrupt service (5 bit identifier).

types.name: SpaceWire line
types.description: Data-strobe line drivers and receivers of a SpaceWire link (LVDS buffers outside the core).

types.name: Packet link
types.description: Network packets on a wide stream: byte 0 of a beat in data bits 7:0, keep contiguous from byte 0 and partial only on the last beat, last marks the end of the packet, user bit 0 on the last beat is the error end of packet (EEP). Further user bits carry a destination index where the source provides one.

types.name: Byte stream
types.description: Byte stream with keep and last and no side band: byte 0 of a beat in data bits 7:0, keep contiguous from byte 0 and partial only on the last beat of a packet.

accepts.note: The side band of the receive port (APID, flags) is not passed on.

types.name: Space Packet send port
types.description: Send port of OpenSPP: one SDU (Octet String Service) or one Space Packet (Packet Service) per stream packet, with the per-SDU side band (APID, packet type, secondary header flag, packet name) in user.

accepts.note: The side band of the send port is set to constants on the connection.

types.name: Space Packet receive port
types.description: Receive port of OpenSPP: one SDU or Space Packet per stream packet, with APID, flags, loss indicator and the user application value in user.

types.name: Space Packet errors
types.description: One-cycle event for every rejected SDU and every discarded packet, with code, port and APID.

types.name: SpaceFibre broadcasts
types.description: Broadcast messages of the SpaceFibre broadcast service (64 bit message, channel and type in user).

types.name: SpaceFibre physical adapter
types.description: Symbol streams, control and status of every lane between the core and its physical adapter.

types.name: SpaceFibre serial lanes
types.description: Serial transceiver lanes and reference clock pins of a SpaceFibre physical adapter.

types.name: RMAP requests
types.description: Commands of the RMAP initiator service (one descriptor per command).

types.name: RMAP request data
types.description: Data bytes of write and read-modify-write commands of the RMAP initiator service.

types.name: RMAP confirmations
types.description: Confirmation of every command of the RMAP initiator service (status, length, error).

types.name: RMAP reply data
types.description: Data bytes of read replies of the RMAP initiator service; last on the last byte.

types.name: RMAP authorisation
types.description: External authorisation of RMAP commands; the request is held until the response.

types.name: RMAP indications
types.description: One-cycle indication of every RMAP command with an intact header, with its header fields and status.

types.name: AES-GCM contexts
types.description: One context per message of the AES-GCM core (direction, key slot, IV source, IV).

types.name: AES-GCM messages
types.description: Messages of the AES-GCM core with the section (IV, AAD, DATA, TAG) of every beat in user.

types.name: AES-GCM status
types.description: Status of every message of the AES-GCM core (code, key slot, IV, section lengths).

types.name: Image samples
types.description: Image samples in the input order of a CCSDS 123.0-B-2 compressor, one sample per beat.

types.name: Error limits
types.description: Error limit values for the periodic error limit updating of a CCSDS 123.0-B-2 compressor.

types.name: AXI4 memory bus
types.description: AXI4 memory-mapped bus (bursts), for example the memory access of an RMAP target.

types.name: AXI4-Lite register bus
types.description: AXI4-Lite register access (32 bit data), for example the register file of a core.

accepts.note: The AXI4 master issues single transfers only, so its AXI4-Lite subset drives the slave.

types.name: Interrupt
types.description: Level interrupt of a register file.

types.name: EDAC events
types.description: Corrected single and detected double bit errors of SECDED-protected memories (pulses or vectors).

types.name: EDAC error injection
types.description: Error injection into SECDED-protected memories, for tests.

types.name: Reset
types.description: Synchronous high-active reset of a clock domain.

types.name: Status signals
types.description: Status outputs of a block (levels, flags), for monitoring.

types.name: Control signals
types.description: Static or slow control inputs of a block.

types.name: Generic stream
types.description: Untyped Open Logic stream; it takes the type of the first interface it is connected to, and the block generics (widths) follow that interface.

blocks.name: FIFO (SECDED)
blocks.summary: Synchronous FIFO whose memory is protected by a SECDED code.

generics.name: Width_g
generics.label: Width
generics.description: Data width.

generics.name: Depth_g
generics.label: Depth
generics.description: Number of entries.

generics.name: RamStyle_g
generics.label: RAM style
generics.description: Vendor RAM style attribute ("auto" lets the tool choose).

blocks.name: Asynchronous FIFO (SECDED)
blocks.summary: FIFO between two clock domains whose memory is protected by a SECDED code; optionally triplicated synchronisers.

constraints.note: Scoped timing constraints of the Open Logic clock crossing.

generics.name: Width_g
generics.label: Width
generics.description: Data width.

generics.name: Depth_g
generics.label: Depth
generics.description: Number of entries (power of 2).

generics.name: RamStyle_g
generics.label: RAM style
generics.description: Vendor RAM style attribute ("auto" lets the tool choose).

generics.name: SyncTmr_g
generics.label: Triplicated synchronisers
generics.description: Implements every synchroniser three times with a majority voter.

blocks.name: Packet FIFO (SECDED)
blocks.summary: Store-and-forward packet FIFO with drop, skip and repeat, memory protected by a SECDED code.
notes: In_Drop on any beat of a packet discards the packet (for example the error end of packet flag of a link on the last beat).

generics.name: Width_g
generics.label: Width
generics.description: Data width.

generics.name: Depth_g
generics.label: Depth
generics.description: Number of entries.

generics.name: SmallRamStyle_g
generics.label: Boundary RAM style
generics.description: Keep "registers" so that the packet boundaries can be covered by vendor TMR.

generics.name: MaxPackets_g
generics.label: Maximum packets
generics.description: Packets the FIFO holds at the same time.

blocks.name: Width converter 1:N
blocks.summary: Packs N input words into one output word; the first input word goes to the lowest bits.
notes: A partially filled output word leaves only with In_Last; a source without last strands its final words.

generics.name: OutWidth_g
generics.label: Output width
generics.description: An integer multiple of the input width.

blocks.name: Width converter N:1
blocks.summary: Splits one input word into N output words, lowest bits first.

generics.name: InWidth_g
generics.label: Input width
generics.description: An integer multiple of the output width.

blocks.name: Width converter N:M
blocks.summary: Converts between any two widths, optionally with byte enables.

generics.name: UseBe_g
generics.label: Byte enables
generics.description: Handles byte enables (both widths a multiple of 8).

blocks.name: Clock crossing with handshake
blocks.summary: Passes data words with valid and ready between two clock domains (low throughput, no RAM).

blocks.name: Clock crossing without handshake
blocks.summary: Passes valid-only data words between two clock domains; no back-pressure, the input rate must be low.

blocks.name: Clock crossing to a faster clock
blocks.summary: Passes data with valid and ready to a clock that is an integer multiple of the input clock and phase aligned.

rules.message: Out_Clk must be an integer multiple of In_Clk and phase aligned.

blocks.name: Clock crossing to a slower clock
blocks.summary: Passes data with valid and ready to a clock that is an integer fraction of the input clock and phase aligned.

rules.message: In_Clk must be an integer multiple of Out_Clk and phase aligned.

blocks.name: Reset generator
blocks.summary: Synchronises an asynchronous reset to a clock and stretches it; optionally triplicated synchronisers.

blocks.name: Pipeline stage
blocks.summary: Register stages with full throughput and registered ready, for timing.

blocks.name: Rate limiter
blocks.summary: Limits a stream to MaxSamples_g beats per Period_g cycles.

blocks.name: CRC append
blocks.summary: Appends a CRC to every packet of a stream.

blocks.name: CRC check
blocks.summary: Checks the CRC at the end of every packet and drops or flags packets with an error.

blocks.name: Chunker
blocks.summary: Splits every packet into chunks of a fixed number of beats (no padding) and marks the end of the input packet.

generics.name: ChunkBeats_g
generics.label: Chunk size
generics.description: Beats of a chunk; the last chunk of a packet may be shorter.

blocks.name: EDAC monitor
blocks.summary: Counts the EDAC events of several memories and keeps a sticky double error flag per channel.

blocks.name: EDAC monitor with registers
blocks.summary: EDAC monitor with an AXI4-Lite register file and an interrupt.

blocks.name: AXI4-Lite decoder
blocks.summary: Connects one AXI4-Lite master to several register files, each in an equal address window.

generics.name: PortAddrWidth_g
generics.label: Window address width
generics.description: Every port owns a window of 2**PortAddrWidth_g bytes.

blocks.name: RMAP node
blocks.summary: RMAP target and initiator according to ECSS-E-ST-50-52C on SpaceWire packet ports, with a memory master, a pass-through port for other protocols and a register file.
notes: Rst is synchronous and high-active; synchronise its release to Clk, for example with olo_base_reset_gen.
M_RepData, M_Conf and M_User must be served when connected; a stalled output stalls the received packet stream and the link.
RMAP address bits above AxiAddrWidth_g must be zero in the windows.
With AxiMaxBeats_g = 1 and AxiDataWidth_g = 32 the memory master issues single transfers only and can drive an AXI4-Lite slave; tie M_Axi_RLast to '1'.

rules.message: At least one of Target_g and Initiator_g must be true.
Two nodes that are initiator and target of each other on one link need Transactions_g = 1.

generics.name: Target_g
generics.label: Target
generics.description: The node executes RMAP commands (ECSS 5.7.1). At least one of Target and Initiator.

generics.name: Initiator_g
generics.label: Initiator
generics.description: The node issues RMAP commands (ECSS 5.7.1). At least one of Target and Initiator.

generics.name: Passthrough_g
generics.label: Pass-through port
generics.description: User port for packets of other protocols; without it they are discarded and counted.

generics.name: AxiAddrWidth_g
generics.label: Memory address width
generics.description: Address width of the memory interface; RMAP address bits above it must be zero.

generics.name: AxiDataWidth_g
generics.label: Memory data width
generics.description: Data width of the memory interface (power of 2); the memory word of single-address accesses.

generics.name: AxiMaxBeats_g
generics.label: Maximum burst length
generics.description: Maximum burst length of the memory interface; 1 makes the memory master usable as AXI4-Lite master.

generics.name: BufferBytes_g
generics.label: Write buffer
generics.description: Maximum Data Length of a verified write.

generics.name: ChunkBytes_g
generics.label: Write chunk
generics.description: Chunk of a non-verified write that is written to memory once it is complete in the buffer.

generics.name: Windows_g
generics.label: Address windows
generics.description: Address windows of the target.

generics.name: ExtAuth_g
generics.label: External authorisation
generics.description: Every command that passes the internal checks is presented for authorisation.

generics.name: TgtAddrBytes_g
generics.label: Target address bytes
generics.description: Maximum length of the target SpaceWire address of a request.

generics.name: Transactions_g
generics.label: Transactions
generics.description: Entries of the transaction table of the initiator; 0 without table and timeout.

generics.name: La0_g
generics.label: Logical address 0
generics.description: Reset value of logical address 0 of the target (enabled after reset).

generics.name: La1_g
generics.label: Logical address 1
generics.description: Reset value of logical address 1 of the target (disabled after reset).

generics.name: DefLaEn_g
generics.label: Default address enabled
generics.description: Reset value of the enable of the default logical address 0xFE.

generics.name: Key_g
generics.label: Key
generics.description: Reset value of the key of the target.

generics.name: TickCycles_g
generics.label: Tick period
generics.description: Reset value of the tick period minus one

generics.name: Timeout_g
generics.label: Reply timeout
generics.description: Reset value of the reply timeout in ticks; 0 disables it.

generics.name: WinInit_g
generics.label: Initial windows
generics.description: Reset values of the windows (WinCfgArray_t of omap_pkg); window 0 open by default.

clocks.label: Clock
clocks.description: All of the core; one character per cycle.

interfaces.name: M_User
interfaces.label: Other protocols out
interfaces.description: Packets whose second character is not the protocol identifier 0x01; unconnected, every packet is accepted.

interfaces.name: S_User
interfaces.label: Other protocols in
interfaces.description: Packets of other protocols, sent unchanged between the RMAP packets.

presets.name: RMAP target
presets.summary: Executes RMAP commands on its memory interface; no initiator.

presets.name: RMAP initiator
presets.summary: Issues RMAP commands and receives the replies; no target.

blocks.name: Space Packet node
blocks.summary: Space Packet Protocol (CCSDS 133.0-B-2) with the CPTP layer of ECSS-E-ST-50-53C: send and receive ports with Octet String or Packet Service, APID routing and a register file.
notes: Rst is synchronous and high-active; synchronise its release to Clk, for example with olo_base_reset_gen.
After the reset the core initialises both APID tables (2048 clock cycles); packets are sent and delivered once the tables are ready.
Serve every receive port, or place a buffer behind a port whose user can stall for long.
TxBufferBytes_g holds the longest SDU of a port, RxBufferBytes_g the longest Space Packet.
Hold the side band (TUser) of a send port constant during an SDU.
The user supplies the packet secondary header at the start of the Octet String and keeps the secondary header flag of an APID static.

generics.label: Stream width

generics.name: NumTx_g

generics.name: NumRx_g

generics.name: RxOctetString_g

generics.name: RxBufferBytes_g
generics.label: Receive buffer
generics.description: Receive buffer shared by all receive ports; holds the longest Space Packet. DataWidth_g / 8 times a power of two.

generics.name: RxMaxPackets_g

generics.name: Encapsulation_g

generics.name: NumDest_g

generics.name: SpwAddrBytes_g

generics.name: MaxLength_g
generics.label: Maximum packet length
generics.description: Reset value of the maximum packet length.

generics.name: RoundRobin_g

generics.description: Reset value of the multiplexing scheme: '0' fixed priority (port 0 first), '1' round robin.

generics.name: Tla_g

generics.name: TxPathDefault_g
generics.label: Send paths enabled

generics.name: RxPathDefault_g

clocks.label: Clock
clocks.description: All of the core; one beat per cycle on every path.

sideband.description: Parameters of the SDU, held constant during the SDU.

fields.name: nameValid
fields.label: Packet name instead of sequence count

interfaces.name: M_Rx
interfaces.label: Receive port
interfaces.description: Must be served; all receive ports share one receive buffer.

interfaces.name: M_Link
interfaces.label: Link out
interfaces.description: Transmitted packets; user bit 0 is the error end of packet, bits 4:1 the destination index.

interfaces.name: S_Link
interfaces.label: Link in
interfaces.description: Received packets; user bit 0 is the error end of packet.

blocks.name: N-Char adapter
blocks.summary: Converts a packet link stream to the N-Char stream of a SpaceWire port (one character per beat, end of packet marker beat) and back.
notes: A received end of packet marker without data characters is discarded.

generics.name: DataWidth_g
generics.label: Link width
generics.description: Width of the link streams; equal to the width of the connected link.

blocks.name: SpaceWire port
blocks.summary: SpaceWire port according to ECSS-E-ST-50-12C Rev.1: encoding, data link and network services (packets, time-codes, distributed interrupts) with a register file.
notes: LVDS output buffers for data and strobe and LVDS input buffers with fail-safe biasing belong to the top level; the core contains no I/O buffer.
Enable the safe implementation of state machines in the synthesis tool.
Set INT_HOLDOFF and INT_ACK_DELAY for the network before distributed interrupts are used.
Serve the indication ports before the indication FIFO (16 entries) fills.
Write registers as 32-bit words; a read that depends on a write waits for the write response.

constraints.note: Place the output flip-flops of data and strobe in the I/O blocks with matched routing.

generics.name: LinkClkFreq_g
generics.label: Link clock frequency
generics.description: Frequency of LinkClk. It must lie within 10 % of a multiple of 10 MHz, so that 10 Mb/s +/- 10 % can be reached with an integer divider.

generics.name: TxFifoDepth_g
generics.label: Transmit FIFO depth

generics.name: RxFifoDepth_g
generics.label: Receive FIFO depth
generics.description: Depth of the receive FIFO in N-Chars (power of 2); 64 or more allows seven outstanding FCTs.

generics.name: Interrupts_g

generics.name: IntTimerWidth_g

generics.name: LinkDisabled_g

generics.name: LinkStart_g

generics.description: Reset value of LinkStart; the port starts the link without software.

generics.name: AutoStart_g
generics.label: Auto start after reset

generics.name: RunDiv_g

generics.name: SyncStages_g

resets.description: Asynchronous reset; the core synchronises its release in every domain.

interfaces.label: Received packets
